Start a MapLibre GL map on a named basemap, fitted to the data

Source: R/gq_mapgl_basemap.R
gq_mapgl_basemap.Rd

The first call of a gq web map: mapgl::maplibre() on one of four keyless basemaps, its view fitted to x. The layers go on with gq_mapgl_network() and gq_mapgl_layer(), and the switches with gq_mapgl_controls().

Usage

gq_mapgl_basemap(
  x,
  basemap = c("voyager", "positron", "openfreemap", "esri_topo"),
  digits = 5L
)

Arguments

x

The extent to fit: an sf or sfc in any CRS, or an sf::st_bbox(). Its coordinates are taken to EPSG:4326 and rounded to digits decimal places, as gq_mapgl_layer() rounds the layers, so the view fits exactly what is drawn.

basemap

"voyager" (Carto Voyager), "positron" (Carto Positron, pale grey), "openfreemap" (OpenFreeMap Liberty) or "esri_topo" (Esri World Topographic Map raster tiles).

digits

Decimal places kept in the coordinates; 5 is about 1 m.

Value

A maplibregl htmlwidget.

Details

Esri's World Topographic Map needs no key, and Esri allows free noncommercial use with attribution, which the map shows: the service's own credit, after "Powered by Esri".

See also

gq_mapgl_network(), gq_mapgl_layer(), gq_mapgl_controls()

Examples

m <- gq_mapgl_basemap(neexdzii_wsd, basemap = "positron")
class(m)
#> [1] "maplibregl" "htmlwidget"
m$x$additional_params$bounds
#> [1] -126.49395   54.49313 -126.11216   54.66072
